verdict.line: You lose if Camille lands Hookshot while your Counter Strike is down; you win almost every fight where you catch her E dive with it up.

brief.thesis: This is a 52.7% Jax favor over 237 games because the whole lane hinges on one interaction: Camille's all-in is built around E (Hookshot) knocking you up to open her Q (Precision Protocol) auto, and Jax's E (Counter Strike) directly answers it by dodging the follow-up autos and stunning her the moment she commits. Whoever's cooldown is up when the dive happens decides the trade.

theirWindow.when: your E (Counter Strike) is on cooldown
theirWindow.what: Counter Strike is down for 18/16/14/12/10s at ranks 1-5, and without it you can't dodge the auto she gets off her Hookshot knockup or the bonus damage from her Q. Play passive and don't contest wave state near walls she can reach with her 800-range Hookshot.

yourWindow.when: Camille dives with E (Hookshot) and your E is up
yourWindow.what: Pop Counter Strike as she leaps in. You dodge every basic attack she throws for its duration, take reduced damage from any AoE, and when it ends you stun everyone around you and deal damage, per OP.GG's own read on this matchup — this is where Jax's solo-kill edge comes from.

start.why: Taken in 56.2% of 178 recorded games (59.7% pick rate). The extra sustain lets you match Camille's auto trades in the 3-5 window without losing the war of attrition before your E cooldown comes down.

boots.why: Run in 52.9% of 172 games (63.5% pick rate). Camille's damage is almost entirely basic attacks and Q procs, so flat physical reduction blunts every trade she initiates, not just her burst windows.

core.why: The most-built first item in the winning path (54.1% wr over 37 games for this route); the damage spike lets you punish any Hookshot dive you catch with E.
Second item in the same 54.1%-win path; the proc and healing on crit keep you winning extended duels once R attack speed is rolling.
The most popular third item in the top build (24.2% pick, 54.1% wr) — buys out her E-into-Q burst window if you mistime Counter Strike.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to survive her all-in after her R comes online (63.6% wr over 11 games as a third item)
she's landing consistent Q and autos on you and you need to bleed through the burst instead of avoiding it (42.9% wr over 7 games, still a listed path)
the game goes long and you need sustained DPS and slow uptime in extended side-lane duels

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the higher-performing page (64.8% wr, 24.3% pick). It stacks attack speed on autos the same way Jax's own R does, so once you land an E stun on her dive you're already ramped up for the follow-up fight.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the most-picked setup (66.8% pick, 51.3% wr) and punishes the exact all-in this brief is built around — Ignite finishes what your E stun starts. Flash+Teleport actually posts a higher 62% win rate over fewer games if you'd rather prioritize wave/tempo control instead of forcing solo kills.

playing.title: Bank E for the wall dive
playing.detail: Don't burn Counter Strike on a minion wave or a poke trade. Its 18/16/14/12/10s cooldown needs to be up specifically for when she jumps a wall with E — that's the fight the whole matchup is decided by.

playing.title: Trade with empowered autos pre-6
playing.detail: Before level 6 you have no answer to a committed Camille all-in, so only take short trades using W (Empower) on your next auto or Leap Strike, then disengage rather than standing in extended exchanges.

playing.title: Respect a delayed Q recast
playing.detail: If Camille's Q (Precision Protocol) goes up and she doesn't immediately recast, she's holding it for the delayed, significantly stronger version — back off rather than trading through it.

playing.title: All-in the instant Counter Strike lands
playing.detail: Once her Hookshot dive gets eaten by your E and she's stunned, commit fully — auto-attack through it and let R's attack speed and bonus-damage-every-third-hit close the fight before she can reset with Q's move speed.

playing.title: Push for Ignite kills off the stun
playing.detail: Jax holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup; a landed Counter Strike stun plus Ignite is usually lethal from level 6 onward if she's dove without flash up.

playing.title: Play around her E cooldown, not just wave state
playing.detail: Track her Hookshot cooldown (16/15/14/13/12s) the way you'd track a jungler's timer — when it's down, she has no engage tool and you can freely shove or roam.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are this brief's own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Use Counter Strike [E] when Camille closes in using Wall Dive (E) to stop her from dealing additional damage. You will have the upper hand if you manage to stun her.
